title: nf-core/deepmutscan pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must not include special characters

file1.errorMessage: FASTQ file for read 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have the extension '.fastq.gz', '.fq.gz', '.fastq' or '.fq'

file2.errorMessage: FASTQ file for read 2 must be provided (paired-end reads are required), cannot contain spaces and must have the extension '.fastq.gz', '.fq.gz', '.fastq' or '.fq'

type.errorMessage: Type must be one of: input, output or wildtype

replicate.errorMessage: Replicate must be a positive integer
